purpose: Evidence layer for Keystone Planner dungeon-aware utility scoring.

basis: Current Patch 12.1 dungeon overview interrupt/dispel/purge tables
Current Midnight Season 2 class-specific Mythic+ utility guides
Conservative research inference for control, movement and defensive categories where guides describe mechanics but do not assign a utility taxonomy
methodology.recoveryOnly: true means the utility primarily recovers a failed/avoidable mechanic rather than being the preferred response

confidence.high: directly supported by a current dungeon/class guide
confidence.medium: supported by encounter facts plus a small utility-type inference
confidence.low: route/meta dependent or conflicting evidence; should not drive a recommendation by itself

mechanics.name: Paralyzing Shots
mechanics.note: Magic DoT/snare; Mass Dispel has explicit value.

mechanics.name: Ravenous / Ravenous Claws
mechanics.note: Attack-speed enrage; overview lists the related effect under important purges.

mechanics.name: Regurgitate
mechanics.note: Disease only matters if the avoidable frontal is taken.

mechanics.name: Toxic Atrophy
mechanics.note: Priority kick; if missed, movement-removal tools can help.

mechanics.name: Death Rattle tether/vines
mechanics.note: Group speed helps players break the tether quickly.

mechanics.name: Evolve
mechanics.note: Hard stops are specifically recommended to prevent Evolve.

mechanics.name: Mass Envenom
mechanics.note: Poison dispel is recovery after a missed cast.

mechanics.name: Fixates / dangerous first-area kiting
mechanics.note: Slows/roots and displacement help stabilize fixates and tank kiting.

mechanics.name: Healing Breeze
mechanics.note: Kick first; purge is the fallback if the cast completes.

mechanics.name: Toxic Spores
mechanics.note: Soaking mushrooms is required; poison removal is a core response.

mechanics.name: Miniboss-before-Sentinel skip
mechanics.note: Warlock guides document a Demonic Gateway route skip.

mechanics.name: High caster density
mechanics.note: Curse of Tongues is called exceptionally powerful here.

mechanics.name: Seduction
mechanics.note: Interrupt is preferred; Tremor/dispels/displacement provide recovery or alternative control.

mechanics.name: Mirror Images
mechanics.note: Guide explicitly calls for controlling the images.

mechanics.name: Killing Spree
mechanics.note: Repeated armor-ignoring group damage.

mechanics.name: Back to Work!
mechanics.note: Class guides identify soothe value for the attack-speed buff.

mechanics.name: Bolster
mechanics.note: Overview classifies it as an important purge; soothe-capable effects should be treated as alternative removal where applicable.

mechanics.name: Route pack skip
mechanics.note: Documented gateway skip; group can also walk around the pack, so this is useful rather than mandatory.

mechanics.name: Aberration-heavy trash
mechanics.note: Shackle Horror is explicitly called out as potentially useful.

mechanics.name: Every mob required for enemy forces
mechanics.note: These route-skip utilities receive zero relevance because the guide states every mob is needed for count.

mechanics.name: Frequent movement and large damage events
Poisoned Cheap Shot
mechanics.note: Dispel is recovery if the stealth attack/cast lands.

mechanics.name: Lingering Storm positioning
mechanics.note: Ring of Peace is explicitly recommended to move enemies out of beneficial zones.
